capacity.label: DL PRB utilisation, busy-hour P95

capacity.label: PRB trend
capacity.definition: Least-squares slope of weekly busy-hour PRB utilisation

capacity.label: RRC-connected users, busy hour
capacity.definition: Mean busy-hour RRC-connected users per site

capacity.label: DL user throughput, busy-hour P10
capacity.definition: 10th percentile of busy-hour DL user throughput

capacity.label: 5G / LTE-A capable device share
capacity.definition: Share of active devices (TAC) supporting 5G NR or LTE-A carrier aggregation

capacity.label: Deployed spectrum per sector
capacity.definition: Sum of carrier bandwidth per sector from configuration management

capacity.label: Neighbour offload headroom
capacity.definition: Mean PRB headroom (100 − PRB) on first-tier neighbours

power.label: Battery state of health
power.definition: Battery management system state of health (capacity vs nameplate)

power.label: Mean depth of discharge
power.definition: Average depth of discharge across mains-failure events

power.label: Mains failures
power.definition: Mains-failure events from PLN feed and site alarms

power.label: Genset run hours
power.definition: Mean daily generator run hours from fuel logs / RMS

power.label: Battery bank age
power.definition: Months since battery installation from site inventory

power.label: Minimum fuel level
power.definition: Lowest tank level recorded in the last 7 days (genset sites)

power.label: Cabinet temperature, max
power.definition: Maximum cabinet temperature (battery life halves per +10 °C)

transport.label: Backhaul utilisation, P95
transport.definition: 95th percentile utilisation of the site's first-hop backhaul link

transport.label: Microwave fade events

transport.label: Fibre cut history

transport.label: Rain forecast, next 7 days

transport.label: Hops to core
transport.definition: Number of transport hops to the aggregation core

ran_hardware.label: Radio / baseband unit age

ran_hardware.label: Age vs vendor MTBF
ran_hardware.definition: Unit age divided by vendor-published MTBF

ran_hardware.label: Alarm recurrence index
ran_hardware.definition: Share of days with a repeat hardware alarm

ran_hardware.label: Hardware swaps
ran_hardware.definition: Hardware replacement tickets on the site

ran_hardware.label: Firmware versions behind
ran_hardware.definition: Software releases behind the vendor baseline

environmental.label: Rain outlook, next dasarian
environmental.definition: BMKG 10-day (dasarian) rainfall outlook for the site grid cell

environmental.label: Site elevation
environmental.definition: Elevation above sea level from site master / DEM

environmental.label: Distance to river or coast
environmental.definition: Distance to nearest river bank or shoreline

environmental.label: Flood events within 2 km
environmental.definition: BNPB recorded flood events within 2 km

environmental.label: Cabinet plinth height

environmental.label: Coastal exposure
